dvids.title: CENTCOM to Launch 1st Bilateral AI Task Force with UAE
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) announced an agreement with the United Arab Emirates, July 28, to establish the first bilateral task force focused on accelerating the development of military artificial intelligence applications.

dvids.title: USS Mahan concludes participation in ‘Rendez-vous Naval de Quebec 2026,’ highlighting lethality and U.S.-Canada defense partnership
dvids.desc:
